Input stream handling is in `CliRunner.isolation()` and `make_input_stream()`. The likely close path is Click’s `File` parameter cleanup during context teardown, which can close the wrapped stdin stream before later reads.

Relevant files:

- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/testing.py?L127-L144](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/testing.py?L127-L144) - Converts string/bytes input to `io.BytesIO`, or extracts a binary reader from an existing stream.
- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/testing.py?L275-L329](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/testing.py?L275-L329) - `CliRunner.isolation()` creates the input stream, optionally wraps it with `EchoingStdin`, and installs `_NamedTextIOWrapper` as `sys.stdin`.
- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/testing.py?L348-L370](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/testing.py?L348-L370) - Click’s prompt and character-reading hooks consume the isolated stdin wrapper.
- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/testing.py?L392-L421](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/testing.py?L392-L421) - Isolation teardown restores the original global streams and Click internals; wrapper destruction/closure can close its underlying input buffer.
- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/testing.py?L423-L534](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/testing.py?L423-L534) - `invoke()` enters isolation, calls `cli.main()`, flushes captured streams in `finally`, then exits isolation.
- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/types.py?L709-L830](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/types.py?L709-L830) - `File` parameter type and context-managed file cleanup; relevant when stdin is passed through a `File` option/argument.
- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/utils.py?L158-L179](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/utils.py?L158-L179) - `LazyFile.close()` and `close_intelligently()`, including the distinction between owned files and stdin.
